# faceted-prompting

This directory contains the library entry points and their transitive local modules from
`faceted-prompting@0.6.1` (https://registry.npmjs.org/faceted-prompting/-/faceted-prompting-0.6.1.tgz).
The original MIT license is preserved in LICENSE.

The implementation and type declarations are unchanged, except for removed source-map
references. The standalone CLI and its update notification dependencies are excluded.
The library exports are preserved. These modules require only Node built-ins.

TAKT loads these files through its package-internal `#faceted-prompting` and
`#faceted-prompting/cli/facet-includes` imports. This directory is shipped as
an internal asset, without an npm dependency on the local directory.
